notes: Only compound of the seven with two independently reported producing strains, both from mangrove sediment on opposite sides of the Pacific. Cytotoxic to P388 and HeLa (IC50 12.8 and 22.5 uM).

Isolation paper is in Tetrahedron Letters and is not indexed in PubMed, which is why name-based PubMed searches return nothing. Cytotoxic to A549, BEL-7402, HL-60, P388 and tsFT210. Collection locality NOT retrieved (paper closed-access; no reviewed source states it). The producing strain shares the designation '007' with Streptomyces fradiae 007 (CMNPD21933); whether these are the same isolate under a revised identification was NOT established by any source retrieved here.
